bio: Malgar is a great adventurer, but not the best guest. Sure, he’ll save your friends from Undead, your roads from bandits, and your parties from boredom… but those parties never end, even after your patience – and coin – are long gone. So, Malgar wanders, hoping his heroism can outpace his creditors.
